signals.text: 1 new PM role posted this week

bullets: Shape the Alpaca Connect / Marketplace roadmap: self-service partner onboarding and approval, app discovery and distribution, OAuth / consent experiences, and platform utilities…
Help drive Trading API product strategy by deeply understanding customer and partner needs and behaviors, analyzing ROI, assessing market competition, and evaluating build-vs-buy…
Define and own product requirements, partnering with engineering, design, operations, data, partnerships, and other cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality products on time
Own product metrics by leveraging data analytics to measure success, identify opportunities, and drive continuous improvement
Guide go-to-market strategy and execution, partnering with marketing, sales, partnerships, and operations to drive product adoption, activation, retention, and revenue growth
Multiple new exchange onboardings in flight, each with its own licensing, entitlement, and redistribution constraints.
A pricing and packaging model that needs rethinking as we expand across asset classes and geographies.
Partners asking for data we don’t serve yet - consolidated feeds, historical datasets, derived analytics - you’ll be building those requests against cost and commercial upside.
Internal teams (trading, algo routing, compliance, clearing) consuming market data with no product owner ensuring coverage keeps pace.
EU market access: scaling from initial access to full product coverage while meeting MiFID II / MiFIR, ESMA, and local NCA requirements.
The rest of the EU roadmap: prioritizing and delivering the next wave of brokerage capabilities across equities, ETFs, and regional market needs.
EU direct connectivity: building and owning connectivity to EU venues and market infrastructure, reducing reliance on intermediary paths.
EU broker partnerships: evaluating, onboarding, and integrating local brokers to expand coverage and resilience.
Cross-border complexity: passporting, multi-jurisdiction onboarding, and coordinating between Alpaca’s global platform and EU market infrastructure.
Own derivatives products for Alpaca, with a primary focus on listed futures and prediction markets.
Drive derivatives product strategy by analyzing ROI, market competition, regulatory requirements, and build-vs-buy scenarios across venues, clearing, and execution.
Contribute to the product roadmap and product strategy with a focus on FCM launch readiness, CFTC/NFA-compliant features, and partner demand for futures and prediction markets.
Write product requirements and work with engineers to execute builds that meet regulatory, exchange, and clearing standards.
Saudi limited live: scaling from initial market access to full product coverage while meeting CMA and Tadawul requirements.
The rest of the Saudi roadmap: prioritizing and delivering the next wave of brokerage capabilities across equities, Sukuk, ETFs, and regional market needs.
Saudi derivatives: defining and launching derivative product offerings compliant with local market structure and regulation.
Saudi direct connectivity: building and owning connectivity to Tadawul and regional infrastructure, reducing reliance on intermediary paths.
Saudi broker partnerships: evaluating, onboarding, and integrating local brokers to expand coverage and resilience.
Defining the long-term architecture for Alpaca’s clearing platform across accounts, positions, balances, ledgers, journals, settlements, stock record, and regulatory books and…
Designing multi-currency cash and position systems that can support global equities, FX, fractional trading, options, bonds, Treasuries, fixed income, mutual funds, and other…
Partnering with engineering to prototype and build new clearing services rather than relying only on third-party service bureau workflows.
Working cross-functionally with operations, finance, treasury, compliance, legal, risk, and product to ensure the platform is scalable, controlled, and regulator-ready.
Translating complex clearing, custody, and regulatory requirements into clear product and engineering requirements.

roles.title: Senior Technical Product Manager: Infrastructure and Platforms

bullets: You have stood up a platform-maturity model, paved-path program, or internal developer platform.
You have eliminated or dramatically reduced maintenance windows or change-freeze culture in a production org.
Multi-region or multi-entity infrastructure: packaging a platform so a new region or booking center can be stood up without a hero project.
Capital markets, brokerage, or other FinTech infrastructure.
